description: As Biden continues to fail America, it’s more important than ever that our state government is ready to fight for a strong border, fight against the woke agenda, and take a stand for the policies and values that made Texas the best place on earth. Jeff Barry is eager to serve my neighbors in a greater capacity and to fight for the people of Brazoria County.
